findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: company_jobs, eth_resolve_ens · Private data: token_risk_check, token_watchlist, token_verdict, deployer_record, solana_token_snapshot, solana_wallet, address_sanctions_screen, prepayment_safety_check, prepayment_safety_check_lite, base_token_snapshot, base_wallet_balances, base_transaction_summary, base_contract_info, base_nft_metadata, base_large_trades, base_new_pools, base_wallet_profile, base_resolve_basename, eth_token_snapshot, eth_wallet_balances, eth_transaction_summary, eth_contract_info, eth_nft_metadata, eth_large_trades, eth_new_pools, eth_wallet_profile, eth_resolve_ens, arbitrum_token_snapshot, arbitrum_wallet_balances, arbitrum_transaction_summary, arbitrum_contract_info, arbitrum_nft_metadata, arbitrum_large_trades, arbitrum_new_pools, arbitrum_wallet_profile, optimism_token_snapshot, optimism_wallet_balances, optimism_transaction_summary, optimism_contract_info, optimism_nft_metadata, optimism_large_trades, optimism_new_pools, optimism_wallet_profile, polygon_token_snapshot, polygon_wallet_balances, polygon_transaction_summary, polygon_contract_info, polygon_nft_metadata, polygon_large_trades, polygon_new_pools, polygon_wallet_profile · Public sink: token_watchlist, token_verdict.

findings.detail: Tool "token_risk_check" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
